message: No Mails to be sent since Resend configuration is not set
reason: The E2E / deploy-smoke / reference-client stacks deliberately leave mail unconfigured, so the embedded server logs this once at startup (embedded/server.go). It is the expected state for a mail-less install, not a failure; a misconfigured Resend account on a real deployment surfaces through the integration health and delivery rows, not this line. Observed 1 on run 38410573640 (Run E2E Tests); startup line, once per stack and a Playwright retry does not restart the server, so the bound stays 1 (#1664).

message: TRUSTED_PROXIES is empty; trusting loopback (127.0.0.1/32, ::1/128) for the bundled nginx. If an external reverse proxy fronts this instance, add its address to TRUSTED_PROXIES — otherwise every client shares the proxy's rate-limit bucket and logged IP.
reason: Every CI stack uses the shipped bundled-nginx deployment, where the only proxy is the loopback nginx and trusting loopback is correct (embedded/server.go). The line is a startup advisory for operators who front the instance with an external proxy; there is no configuration in these stacks that would silence it without diverging from the documented deployment. message: webhook delivery will not be retried
reason: e2e/systemEvents.spec.ts registers one webhook pointed at a permanent-404 receiver and fires it once, then tops the admin log up until it holds 101 rows (WINDOW+1), so on a fresh log this warn (and the integration_failed system event it records) is raised up to 101 times; a Playwright retry re-fires only once because the log is already full. Bound 110 = 101 plus a handful for other webhook-failure events recorded earlier in the same stack. Scoped to component=webhook. Observed 98 on run 38410573640 (Run E2E Tests; 0 in the production-defaults leg); not doubled to 196 because the log window caps rows at 101 and a retry re-fires only once, so 110 keeps ~12% headroom (#1664).
